header.title: Forecast
header.description: What revenue and work is coming?
header.scope: The next 6 months, from Nov 2026 · against the forecast a week ago · whole agency

status.label: Off track
status.target: Coverage 0.0× of the next three months' revenue target · target 1.2× · Watch below 1.0×, Off track below 0.7×

info.name: Open pipeline
info.definition: The value of every open deal; coverage is the weighted pipeline of the next three months (value × chance, the deals expected to start in them) against those months' revenue target.
info.formula: Σ value of open deals · coverage = weighted pipeline, next 3 months ÷ revenue target, next 3 months
info.period: From today on; the period picker does not change it.

kpis.label: Win rate
kpis.no_change_reason: Not recorded for Dec 2025–May 2026: recording started on 1 Aug 2026

info.name: Win rate
info.definition: Deals won as a share of those won or lost, by count, closed in the period.

kpis.label: Days to close
kpis.no_change_reason: Not recorded for Dec 2025–May 2026: recording started on 1 Aug 2026

info.name: Days to close
info.definition: The mean days from a deal being made to its win, for those won in the period.
info.formula: Σ days from creation to won ÷ deals won

kpis.sub: From made to won, Jun–2 Nov 2026

expected.title: Expected work by month
expected.subtitle: Each open deal's reference hours times its chance of winning, in the month it is expected to start; deals from Proposal sent on

info.name: Weighted forecast
info.definition: Open deals at the forecast stage in Settings or beyond, expected to start in the months ahead, each at its value times its chance of winning (its own, else its stage's in Settings).
info.formula: Σ value × chance, deals from the forecast stage on, by expected start month
info.period: From today on; the period picker does not change it.

capacity.title: Can the team take it?
capacity.subtitle: Hours the likely deals need (from Proposal sent on) against the free hours each department has, after booked work

info.name: Hours coming
info.definition: The service reference hours of deals at the forecast stage or beyond, by department, from each deal's expected start.
info.formula: Σ reference hours, by department and expected start
info.period: From today on; the period picker does not change it.

deals.title: Deals from Proposal sent on
deals.subtitle: The hours each needs; values are not shown to you

funnel.title: Stage funnel
funnel.subtitle: Open deals at each stage, as things stand
